definitions.explanation: Refers to a philharmonic orchestra, typically as part of the proper name of an ensemble (e.g., {東京|とうきょう}フィルハーモニー{交響楽団|こうきょうがくだん}). From German "Philharmonie." Often shortened to フィル in casual reference.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}フィルハーモニーの{演奏会|えんそうかい}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to a Tokyo Philharmonic concert.

examples.japanese: ベルリン・フィルハーモニーは{世界|せかい}{最高|さいこう}{峰|ほう}のオーケストラだ。
examples.english: The Berlin Philharmonic is one of the world's top orchestras.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はフィルハーモニーの{首席|しゅせき}{指揮|しき}{者|しゃ}に{就任|しゅうにん}した。
examples.english: He was appointed principal conductor of the philharmonic.

notes:
Loanword from German "Philharmonie" (philharmonic society/orchestra). Found almost exclusively in proper names of orchestras; rarely used as a standalone common noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {東京|とうきょう}フィルハーモニー{交響楽団|こうきょうがくだん}: Tokyo Philharmonic Orchestra
- ベルリン・フィルハーモニー: Berlin Philharmonic
- フィル: shortened form used in casual reference

SIMILAR WORDS:
- オーケストラ: orchestra — generic term
- {交響楽団|こうきょうがくだん}: symphony orchestra — formal Japanese equivalent
